description: Changes a webhook endpoint's URL, events, note, or turns it on or off; only the fields you send change. Use when the user wants to point a webhook elsewhere, change its events, or pause or resume it. Not for removing it (use delete_items with type webhook). Returns the updated endpoint. Team managers only. Turning it off drops pending retries.

description.description: New note for your team, max 200 characters. Send an empty string to clear it.

events.description: Events to send, 1 or more: workout_session.completed = a member finished a workout; plan.started = a member started a program; plan.progress_updated = program progress changed; plan.completed = a member finished a program; insights.digest_ready = a client insights digest is ready; * = all events, now and future. E.g. ["workout_session.completed"].

status.description: enabled = deliveries on; disabled = deliveries stop now and pending retries are dropped (events stay in the feed for 30 days).

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

url.description: New public HTTPS URL, max 2048 characters, e.g. "https://api.yourapp.com/hooks".

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook endpoint. Get it from list_webhooks.

name: update_webhook
title: Update webhook
